notes.subject: 2026 route lead - Cascades Futurity
notes.body: Current official information places Cascades Futurity & Aged Event at Deschutes County Fairgrounds, 3800 SE Airport Way, Redmond OR. The event is active through the leg manager's open post-Labor-Day window and is a strong route fit after Lakeview. Official contact page lists Julie Clarke as Show Producer / Show Manager at 503-799-1355, but the website masks the email address in the available source, so do not guess an email. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found. Commercial angle: prepaid first because Oregon is weather-restricted; Old Farmer's Almanac currently shows Sept. 1-10 sunny and very warm in the Pacific Northwest, so pay-for-play can remain a secondary option if requested. Sources verified Aug. 27, 2026: cascadesfuturity.com and Old Farmer's Almanac.
